Card Q&A.a: If you have a Digimon with [Hybrid] in its traits in your battle area, you can use this Option card even if you don’t have a white Digimon or Tamer in play.
Card Q&A.q: “If you have a Digimon with [Hybrid] in its traits in play, you may use this Option card without meeting its color requirements.“ How does this effect work, exactly?

Effect: If you have a Digimon with [Hybrid] in its traits in play, you may use this Option card without meeting its color requirements.
[Main] Your level 4 Digimon can digivolve into 1 Digimon card in your hand with matching colors and [Ten Warriors] in its traits for its digivolution cost, ignoring its level.
Security Effect: [Security] Add this card to its owner's hand.
